title: feat(spec)!: a dimensionless dashboard widget declares two or more measures only on a type that renders them — refuse pie / donut / funnel / scatter / radar / treemap / sankey at values (objectui#8894 ruling D)
body:
Fixes #20958
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

Applies maintainer ruling D's principle (objectui#8894, `5643392537`: 「协议不正确的应该先修改协议」) to the chart types: a dashboard widget with **no dimension** may declare two or more measures only on a type that renders them. The metric-family narrowing (`09e16a574`) was the ruling's first application; this is the same principle on `pie`, `donut`, `funnel`, `scatter`, `radar`, `treemap` and `sankey`. The direction was not re-opened here.

## What changed

- **`DASHBOARD_WIDGET_MULTI_MEASURE_TYPES`** (new export, `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts`) is the one list: `table`, `pivot`, `bar`, `column`, `horizontal-bar`, `line`, `area`, `combo`, typed `as const satisfies readonly ChartType[]`. The check, its refusal text and the `values` doc string all read it. No second literal of the set exists in code (a test pins one `export const` declaration).
- **`checkDashboardWidgetDimensionlessMeasureArity`** (new export) is an object-level check chained onto `DashboardWidgetSchema` by identifier, right after `checkDashboardWidgetMetricMeasureArity`. It refuses when `dimensions` is absent or `[]`, `values` has two or more members, and `type` is a declared `ChartTypeSchema` member outside the multi-measure set and outside the metric family. It emits ONE `custom` issue at `values` naming the widget `id`, the count and the type, lists the multi-measure set (read from the constant), and steers to `type: 'table'` (a row of measures), a bar-family type (`bar` / `column` / `horizontal-bar`), or one widget per measure.
- **The metric family is excluded on purpose.** `checkDashboardWidgetMetricMeasureArity` already refuses a second measure on `metric` / `kpi` / `gauge` / `solid-gauge` / `bullet` (and a typeless widget, which defaults to `metric`) at any dimensionality. Firing here too would turn that existing refusal from one issue into two. So every type outside the multi-measure set is refused dimensionless by exactly one of the two checks, and the metric refusal is byte-identical (pinned: same message as the metric export's direct call, one issue).
- **A type the spec does not declare is not judged by the export.** Through this door it is unreachable (zod's `invalid_value` on `type` aborts object-level checks). objectui's mirror, however, re-points `type` at a wider enum (`list`, `custom`, component widget types) with no default, so the export returns on anything outside `ChartTypeSchema.options`. It refuses exactly what the spec's door refuses.
- **ADR-0087 semantic entry** `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.dashboard-widget-dimensionless-multi-measure-refused.ts`, plus the `gen:migration-registry` lap. Nothing was hand-edited between the markers. Its acceptance criteria name the doors as measured (below), state that the TODO cannot name per-document measures, and list what is and is not refused.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/20958-dimensionless-multi-measure-refused.md`: `minor`, **BREAKING** banner, the ADR-0087 marker `registered dashboard-widget-dimensionless-multi-measure-refused`, the `Clause-②` line, and a FROM → TO table.
- **Regenerated:** `api-surface/ui.json` and `export-origins/ui.json` (+2 exports each, 0 removed), and the `values` row of `content/docs/references/ui/dashboard.mdx`.

## Measured before building (the dispatch's three hypotheses)

**Premise at the base `05be35259`** (built `dist`, `DashboardWidgetSchema.safeParse`): a widget with no dimensions and `values: ['a', 'b']` returned ACCEPT on every one of the seven types. The metric family returned REFUSE `values:custom` at every dimensionality. `bogusProp` on the same widget returned REFUSE `unrecognized_keys`, which is the lit control.

**H1, attachment points.** In this repo the metric check is attached at exactly one place: the `.superRefine` chain of `DashboardWidgetSchema`. `DashboardSchema.widgets`, `ObjectStackDefinitionSchema.dashboards` and the `dashboard` metadata-type schema all reach it through that schema (`git grep` over `packages/**`: no other construction of the widget schema, no `.shape` mirror in this repo). The new check is chained at the same point. The "editor face" the precedent entry names is objectui's `.shape` mirror, which lives outside this repo (see Downstream).

**H2, every door by the schema alone.** The subject is a dimensionless two-measure widget. The controls are the same body as `table` / `bar`, and a `pie` carrying one dimension.

| door | subject (pie / donut / sankey / radar) | controls |
|---|---|---|
| `DashboardSchema`, `getMetadataTypeSchema('dashboard')` | REFUSE `widgets.0.values:custom` | ACCEPT |
| `ObjectStackDefinitionSchema` | REFUSE `dashboards.0.widgets.0.values:custom` | ACCEPT |
| `defineStack` | throws `defineStack validation failed (1 issue)`, naming the widget | returns |
| `os validate` (a config built by `defineStack`) | exit 1 at the same `defineStack` issue | get past the schema step; exit 1 later on an unrelated docs-namespace rule of the probe app |
| metadata save path (`saveMetaItem`, ACTIVE and DRAFT) | `422 INVALID_METADATA` at `widgets.0.values`, 0 rows persisted | ACTIVE save succeeds, 1 row |

No consumer-side copy exists. The probes were one-shot: a scratch config and a scratch test file, both deleted, and `git status` was clean afterwards.

**H3, fixtures and stored rows.** I ran a census at `05be35259` over every tracked `.ts` / `.tsx` / `.js` / `.json` / `.md` / `.mdx`. 469 brace-local literals carry `values: [...]`. 23 of them are on one of the seven types, and every one has one dimension and one measure. That leaves 0 dimensionless multi-measure widgets on the seven. Lit control: the same scan classifies 40 dimensionless multi-measure literals of other kinds (reports, metric-family test fixtures, dataset selections). An objectui checkout at `1263e40` gives 8 seven-type literals and 0 dimensionless multi-measure. No fixture needed triage, and the stop condition did not fire.

## Verification

All of the following ran at `e1494c720`, after merging `origin/main` `9b0de7de7` through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`. On that merge, `api-surface/ui.json` and `export-origins/ui.json` were regenerated from the merged tree and now hold main's new exports plus this branch's two.

**Reverse verification** ran at the committed `1a0e75a6d` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. It deleted only the `.superRefine(checkDashboardWidgetDimensionlessMeasureArity)` attachment, so the function stayed declared. The subject is imported from `src` through a relative path, so no `dist` was involved.

## Acceptance notes

None of these is filed. None is a reproducible defect, a contract violation or an authoring trap.

- **Whether the seven types render several measures WITH a dimension** is unmeasured here and outside the card. The rule refuses only the dimensionless shape; the entry and the docblock say so rather than imply it. Carrier: none.
- **No `STEP18_RATIONALE` fragment** was added. This follows the precedent (`09e16a574` added none). The step currently holds 52 fragments against 254 major-18 semantic entries (this one included), and fragments accompany retirements that carry conversions. The dispatch's hot-file note describes the fragment mechanism; nobody else's fragment was touched.
- **Two new exports, not one.** The card names one exported constant. The check itself is exported too, because `object-refinement-check-exports.test.ts` pins one export per `custom` check the schema carries, and objectui's mirror chains the check by name. `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` covers both.
- **`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`** refuses a replacement that is a substring of its anchor, because the replacement count cannot rise. This is conservative and correct; the remedy is a distinctive marker. Carrier: none.

## Downstream: objectui's mirror (not in this PR)

`@object-ui/types` builds `DashboardWidgetSchema` from a `.shape` spread, so it runs only the checks it chains. Until it chains this one, its editor keeps accepting a dimensionless two-measure `pie`, and the author meets the refusal at publish. The entry says so. For the coordination child:

- Import `checkDashboardWidgetDimensionlessMeasureArity` (and, for any UI that lists the set, `DASHBOARD_WIDGET_MULTI_MEASURE_TYPES`) from `@objectstack/spec/ui`.
- Chain it in `packages/types/src/zod/complex.zod.ts` after the existing `.superRefine(checkDashboardWidgetMetricMeasureArity)`.
- Add it to the `attached` list of the `DashboardWidgetSchema (complex.zod.ts)` row in `packages/types/src/__tests__/spec-object-refinements-7715.test.ts`. That census reads the spec object's check count, so it reddens by row name at the spec bump until this lands.
- Refusal shape: ONE issue with `code: 'custom'` and `path: ['values']`. The message starts "Widget `ID` declares N measures with no `dimensions` on `type: 'T'`", where ID is the widget id, N is the count and T is the authored type.
